subject: Crafthub SDK & tracing: LangChain/LlamaIndex interoperability initiative
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@crafthub.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@crafthub.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership: LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + Crafthub SDK integration

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking a look — we chatted briefly at AI Integrations Summit and Crafthub is excited to explore a tighter product integration with Redwood Inference. We ship a lightweight orchestration SDK used by a number of LangChain and LlamaIndex customers; several prospects have asked for turnkey tracing into vendor runtimes and a first-class instrumented path into Redwood.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood tracing hooks + telemetry keys for agent/KV cache events (so we can emit compatible spans)
- Compatibility checklist for LangChain Agents (v0.0.28+) and LlamaIndex node flows
- A small reference adapter pattern (best if this can be an upstream pull request / example repo)

We attached a draft SOW that outlines a co-engineered pilot and a lightweight adapter spec. Proposed timeline: kickoff this month, engineering spike week 2, reference adapter and docs by end of month.

Attachments: [crafthub-sow-draft.pdf], [adapter-spec.md]

Would you be able to route this to the right technical contact? We can present a short demo and proposed acceptance criteria on a 30-minute call.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Partnerships, Crafthub
asha@crafthub.ai
https://crafthub.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@crafthub.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership: LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + Crafthub SDK integration

Hi Asha — great to reconnect and thanks for the materials.

This is exactly the kind of partner integration we should prioritize for ISV co-sell. Vanessa, Marissa — looping you both in for engineering/partnership scoping.

Asha — quick answers up front:
- We have a documented tracing contract for runtime and agent events; happy to share the contract and a short telemetry sample.
- LangChain and LlamaIndex compatibility depends mostly on the adapter surface (prompt tokens, KV cache boundaries). We can map expectations in a simple checklist.

Next steps I propose:
1) 30-min kickoff this week to agree on outcomes and acceptance criteria (OKR: reference adapter + docs + joint demo).
2) Vanessa and Marissa will own the technical kickoff and run the spike.
3) Provide any compliance/enterprise packaging needs early if this pilot should be used for sales demos.

Two quick scheduling options: Wed 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 14:00-14:30 PT. Which works for you?

Thanks — looking forward to steering this.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of ISV Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@crafthub.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership: LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + Crafthub SDK integration

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 9:12 AM Asha Patel <asha@crafthub.ai> wrote:
> We ship a lightweight orchestration SDK used by a number of LangChain and LlamaIndex customers; several prospects have asked for turnkey tracing into vendor runtimes and a first-class instrumented path into Redwood.

Thanks, Asha — excited to dig in. A few pragmatic asks from the Redwood engineering side so we can scope the spike effectively:

1) Sample trace/event schema: can you share a short JSON example of the events you emit for agent steps, tool calls, and cache hits? We map those into our runtime spans and want to validate cardinality.
2) LangChain agent hooks: which versions of LangChain are you instrumenting today? We recommend focusing the pilot on 0.0.28+ (agent interface stabilized).
3) LlamaIndex flows: identify the common retrieval patterns (document nodes vs. chunked embeddings) so we can ensure cache boundary alignment.
4) Security/compliance: if any enterprise customers will use the adapter, please flag required fields (PII scrubbing, retention preferences).

I've attached a short interoperability checklist that captures our minimum acceptance criteria and suggested pre-kickoff agenda: [interop-checklist.xlsx].

Proposed agenda for the 30-min kickoff:
- 5m introductions, outcomes
- 10m demo from Crafthub of the SDK + sample traces
- 10m mapping of trace keys + adapter contract
- 5m success criteria & next milestones

Jordan — Wed 10am PT works for me. Asha — can Ben or your engineering lead join the demo?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships & GTM Technical Alliances
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Ben Hollis <ben.h@crafthub.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Asha Patel <asha@crafthub.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership: LangChain/LlamaIndex tracing + Crafthub SDK integration

Thanks Vanessa, Jordan — appreciate the clear agenda and checklist. Quick replies inline and next steps: 

- Sample traces: attached a small zip with JSON samples (agent-step-events.json) and a short mapping doc (adapter-spec.md). We structure agent events as: {trace_id, span_id, step_type, tool, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_hit}. We'll add a mapping to Redwood's telemetry keys (thank you for the checklist).
- LangChain versions: we currently test against 0.0.28 and 0.0.30; focusing on 0.0.28+ for the pilot is fine.
- LlamaIndex: our most common flow is retrieval-augmented generation using node-level retrieval; we'll annotate the adapter to map node ids to Redwood's cache keys.
- Security: no PII is emitted by default. For enterprise demos we can support a retention flag and a small config to drop or hash sensitive fields.

Attachments: [adapter-spec.md], [agent-step-events.json]

Next steps: Wed 2027-06-09 10:00 PT (confirmed via calendar invite). On the call we will do a 7–10 minute demo and hand the rest of the time to mapping and acceptance criteria. After the call we'll open a joint repo (Crafthub/redwood-adapter) and aim for a spike branch in 5 business days.

Doc link for signature / SOW: https://app.docusign.com/s/Crafthub-Redwood-SOW (we can sign after scope alignment).

Looking forward to it.

—Ben Hollis
Senior Eng Manager, Integrations, Crafthub
ben.h@crafthub.ai
